WYSIWYG was founded on April 1, 1999, by Xavier LOPEZ.

WYSIWYG stands for: "What You See Is What You Get."

It means: "What you see is what you get."

hero.eyebrow: A sovereign solution hosted in France
hero.subtitle: A collaborative platform to streamline your communication.
hero.lead: Professional email, shared calendar, unified contacts: BlueMind brings together all your company's collaboration tools in a single interface, sovereign, high-performing, and hosted in our datacenters in France.

statement.title: A complete collaborative suite, hosted with full sovereignty.
statement.text: Optimal productivity and availability — with no dependency on a foreign cloud.

features.title: Features
items: Email, calendar, and contacts brought together in a single web interface.
Native mobile sync with your smartphones and tablets.
Shared calendars and resource management (rooms, equipment).
Compatible with open protocols: IMAP, SMTP, CalDAV, CardDAV.
Daily backups and a disaster recovery plan.
Guided migration from Exchange or any other system.
features.note: Your data stays hosted in our datacenters, under French law, with a collaborative experience designed for your teams, wherever they work.

sovereignty.title: The only professional messaging solution designed, built, and hosted in France.

cards.title: French datacenters
cards.text: Your data stays located in France, governed exclusively by French law, with no transfer to a foreign cloud.

cards.title: Open standards
cards.text: No proprietary lock-in: IMAP, SMTP, CalDAV, and CardDAV guarantee full compatibility with your existing tools.

cards.title: GDPR by design
cards.text: An infrastructure designed from the ground up to protect your organization's personal data.
